Manifest 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces Manifest, a smart LLM router and observability plugin for OpenClaw.
- Routes requests to the most cost-effective model with ultra-low latency.
- Provides a real-time dashboard for tracking costs, tokens, and usage.
- Enables spending limits and email alerts.
- Supports setup for both local and cloud deployments.
- Offers three built-in agent tools: usage, cost, and health monitoring.
- Compatible with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and more).
- Full documentation and open source under MIT license.
